text: **Verdict: False, as a general claim.** From low Earth orbit, the Great Wall is too narrow and often too similar in color to its surroundings to be reliably distinguished with the naked eye. Some sections might be picked out under exceptional conditions or with optical aid, but it is not routinely visible unaided—and it is not visible from the Moon.
